title: Propagate Preintegration Covariance
summary: `preintegration_covariance(rotation_vectors, specific_force, durations, noise_variance)` rotation_vectors(N,3) body-frame integrated angular increments radians, norm<=3; force(N,3) bias-corrected body specificforce m/s² abs<=100;dt(N)seconds[1e-6,1],sum<=100,N0..1024;noise_variance(N,6) in[0,100], per-sample discrete variances of gyroscope(rad/s) then accelerometer(m/s²), NOT continuous spectral densities. Start rotation R=I,cov P=zeros9. State error order(theta radians,velocity m/s,position m), theta right-local current-body, velocity/position initialbody. For eachOLD R and h=dt, phi=rotvec, E=Exp(phi), rightJacobian Jr=I−(1−cosθ)/θ²[phi]x+(θ−sinθ)/θ³[phi]x² with analytic small-angle continuation. A block rows [[E.T,0,0],[-R[f]x h,I,0],[-.5R[f]x h²,I h,I]]. B block rows [[Jr h,0],[0,R h],[0,.5R h²]]. P'=A P A.T+B diag(q) B.T, symmetrize roundoff; R'=R E. Return covariance(N+1,9,9) and final_rotation(3,3). This reproduces the nine-state first-order noise recurrence with supplied increments, fixed biases, and diagonal discrete sensor noise; no bias random walk or continuous-noise discretization. Exampleonezero-rotation/force step h1,qgyro1,qaccel4=>diagtheta1,diagv4,diagp1 and each matching v/p covariance2. ExampleN0=>singlezero9matrix,Ridentity. Independent oracle propagates noise impulse columns through the error recurrence before forming their Gram matrix.
